big_picture.title: Nasdaq, Russell 2000 Snap Big Losing Streaks As This Stock Market Sector Cries Out For First Aid
big_picture.excerpt: The stock market is stuck in a correction even as two key equity indexes halted a brutal run of declines.
paragraphs: The stock market correction remains firmly intact, even if two key indexes finally halted a brutal slide. Meanwhile, the medical sector exemplified the topsy-turvy nature of growth stocks lately.

In other financial arenas, oil fell hard. Gold and silver kept plunging as the U.S. dollar continues to climb. And bond buyers returned to long-dated U.S. Treasury securities. West Texas Intermediate crude slumped 3% to around $82 a barrel. The yield on the benchmark 10-year bond slipped 3 basis points to 5.06%.
